Item 5.07 Submission of Matters to a Vote of Security Holders.

On February 19, 2026, IES held its 2026 Annual Stockholders Meeting (the “ Annual Meeting”). At the Annual Meeting, the Company’s stockholders (1) elected all of the Company’s nominees for Director, (2) ratified the appointment of Ernst & Young LLP as the Company’s certified public accountants for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026, and (3) approved, by advisory vote, the compensation of the Company’s named executive officers, each as described in the proxy statement for the Annual 
Meeting.
